repair.name: minimum diagonal loading
repair.cross_gram_rule: all source-validation and target cross-Grams remain raw and unchanged
repair.interpretation: Minimum diagonal loading restores a PSD training block and therefore a convex precomputed-SVM training problem. The loaded matrix is a post-hoc regularized similarity matrix, not a normalized fidelity Gram; cross-Gram estimates remain unchanged and no global Mercer extension is claimed.

raw_replay_validation.note: E16 did not persist the large Gram arrays. The original stable RNG, frozen inputs, six shot budgets and five kernel seeds were replayed; every archived primary per-configuration summary matched before PSD repair was evaluated.
